name: verify-user-outcomes
permissions: read repository files and intent documents
run the declared test command with an argument array and no shell
risks: a test that matches the id but asserts nothing passes an unverified outcome
a disconnected result passes because only internal helpers were tested
an agent edits acceptance criteria to make a failing outcome pass
mitigations: zero-match selectors are errors and skipped tests are inconclusive
the scenario must reach the consumer boundary, shown by discrimination runs
stale references are findings and fail the affected outcome
acceptance changes require a separate maintain-mode diff with a stated reason
ethical_considerations: do not present fixture-level assertions as live or production behavior
